Millbrook’s population increased from 34,590 in 2020 to 37,203 in 2025, a growth factor of 37,203 ÷ 34,590. Applying the same percentage growth to 2030:

37,203 × (37,203 ÷ 34,590) ≈ 40,014 residents.

This exceeds 40,000.

ANSWER: yes | 40014
